MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.

2. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.

4. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   B. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance.

5. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   D. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

10. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   C. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
